marketSignal.title: Market signal
marketSignal.intro: What owners say about their communities — collected by the dashboard card, voluntarily and after their first own post. No names, just distributions.
marketSignal.empty: No answers to this question yet.
marketSignal.truncated: This evaluation shows only an excerpt — there are more communities than were queried.

reservedNames.title: Reserved names
reservedNames.help: These pukalani.app subdomains are never handed out to a community — the platform's own names are fixed in code, your own entries can be added and released here at any time.
reservedNames.formNotePlaceholder: What is this name meant for?
reservedNames.deleteConfirmText: “{name}.pukalani.app” can be claimed by a customer afterwards.
reservedNames.deleteFailedHint: It stays reserved. Try again — if that doesn't help, reload the page.
reservedNames.errorInvalid: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only (not at the start or end), 36 characters at most.
reservedNames.errorSystem: This name belongs to the platform and is already reserved permanently.
reservedNames.errorExists: This name is already on your list.

requests.title: Early access requests
requests.subtitle: Who wants to start a community? Assigning sends an email with code and direct link right away — you never see the code, it only exists between generation and sending.
requests.assignedHint: The email with code and direct link is out, the code is valid for 14 days. We don't know the plaintext — if it gets lost, only "Remind" helps.
requests.assignFailedHint: No code was sent. The request may have been redeemed or deleted in the meantime — reload the list.
requests.mailFailed: The code was issued, but the email did not go out — check SMTP and send a reminder.
requests.remindedHint: The previous code is revoked by this — only the new one works.

remindBlocked.limit: Three reminders is the limit — reach out personally.

requests.updateFailedHint: The state of the request is unchanged — reload the list and try again.

invites.title: Invite codes
invites.subtitle: During early access, creating a community requires a code. The plaintext appears exactly ONCE — when you issue it.

gate.label: Creating your own community requires an invite code
gate.onHint: Early access: only people with a code can create a community. Signing up and joining other communities stays open to everyone.
gate.offHint: Off: anyone with an account can create their own community right away. The codes below stay untouched and take effect again once you switch this back on.
gate.savedOnHint: Creating a community requires an invite code again.
gate.savedOffHint: Anyone with an account can now create their own community.
gate.saveFailedHint: Nothing changed. Please try again in a moment.

invites.createFailedHint: No code was issued. Check redemptions and validity, then try again.
invites.labelHint: For you only — helps you remember what the code was for.
invites.expiresHint: 0 = no expiry. A code without expiry is valid forever — when in doubt, set a limit.
invites.issuedHint: Copy it now. It is not stored and cannot be recovered — lost means issuing a new one.
invites.copyFailed: Copying failed — please type it out.
invites.revokedHint: It can no longer be redeemed. Anyone who already created a community with it keeps it.
invites.reactivatedHint: It can be redeemed again — up to its expiry date.
invites.updateFailedHint: The state of the code is unchanged. Try again.

stock.lowHint: Refill the stock before the next request has to wait.
stock.fillHint: Creates empty slots. A real code only comes into being when it is assigned to a request — so no finished secrets are ever lying around.
stock.expiresHint: Shelf life of the slot itself. The assigned code gets a fresh 14 days regardless.
stock.createFailedHint: No slots were created. Between 1 and 100 per run are allowed.
stock.onlyFree: {count} free slots in stock — nothing handed out yet. Assigned codes show up here.
stock.truncated: More than 1000 codes: these numbers are a lower bound.

websites.title: Websites
websites.registeredHint: The website is in the register now — "Check" in the row menu fetches its health status right away.
websites.registerFailedHint: The slug is probably taken already — every website needs its own. Check the fields and try again.

healthHint.ok: Appwrite endpoint and app URL both respond.
healthHint.degraded: Only one of the two addresses responds — check the Appwrite endpoint and app URL in the register.
healthHint.down: Neither the Appwrite endpoint nor the app URL responds. Is the process running on the server?

websites.healthFailedHint: The status could not be determined — that does not mean the website is down. Is it still in the register?
websites.deregisterConfirm: Remove "{name}" from the register? The Appwrite project and its data stay untouched.
websites.deregistered: "{name}" has been removed from the register.
websites.deregisterFailedHint: The website is still in the register. Its Appwrite project is not affected either way.
websites.reauthText: Your last sign-in was more than 10 minutes ago. Sign in again briefly — you will come straight back here and can deregister the website. Nothing has been deregistered.

jobs.title: Provisioning
jobs.fieldProductsHelp: core + system are always included; dependencies are selected automatically.
jobs.catalogEmpty: Product catalog is empty — run pnpm control:jobs once.
jobs.created: Job for {name} created — the runner takes over.
jobs.createdHint: It waits until "pnpm control:jobs" runs — progress shows up below under "Provisioning".
jobs.createFailedHint: The name is probably taken already, or a job for it is still running. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens are allowed.

entitlements.title: Products for {name}
entitlements.help: Granted products (F3 precursor) — signing and delivery to the site follow with the billing rollout.
entitlements.saveFailedHint: The previous grant set still applies. Try again.

tenants.title: Communities
tenants.subtitle: Host-to-customer register of the platform app: one row per customer domain — a new pool community goes live with a single entry (no build). Disabled hosts return 404 within 30 seconds.
tenants.createdHint: {host} responds as soon as the host cache picks it up (30 seconds at most) — DNS must point to the platform app.
tenants.createFailedHint: Nothing was created. The host is probably taken already or reserved for the platform — check name and host.
tenants.enabledHint: The host responds again within 30 seconds.
tenants.disabledHint: The host returns 404 within 30 seconds. The community's data stays untouched.
tenants.registrationOpenHint: Anyone who signs up on this host joins the community automatically.
tenants.registrationClosedHint: From now on, only invited people get into the community.
tenants.updateFailedHint: The change was not saved — the community is unchanged. Reloading shows the real state.
tenants.deletedHint: {host} is no longer reachable. The community's data in the Appwrite project remains.
tenants.deleteFailedHint: The community is still in the register and reachable. Try again.
tenants.reauthText: Your last sign-in was more than 10 minutes ago. Sign in again briefly — you will come straight back here and can delete the community. Nothing has been deleted.
tenants.hostHelp: Canonical hostname, lowercase, no port — e.g. kunde-a.pukalani.app. DNS must point to the platform app.
tenants.modeHelp: Pool: shared project, rows scoped per community. Silo: own Appwrite project.
tenants.projectHelp: Pool: the shared pool project. Silo: the customer’s own project.

validation.hostReserved: This subdomain is reserved for the platform

tenants.name: Customer name
tenants.nameHelp: The subdomain is suggested from this name — you can still edit it.
tenants.waveHelp: Silo schema updates roll out in three waves: internal (own tests) → canary (a few volunteers) → stable (everyone). Pool communities share one project — the wave has no effect for them.
tenants.waveChangedHint: Takes effect with the next schema rollout for this silo.
tenants.planHelp: Tiers the usage limits of the pool community (e.g. comments per day). Silo customers have no limit.
tenants.planChangedHint: The new plan's limits take effect in the pool within 90 seconds.
tenants.confirmDeleteText: Permanently delete {host}? The community will no longer be reachable.

suspend.intro: The community {host} will be suspended. Nothing is deleted and it can be undone at any time.
suspend.kindHelp: Read-only is a reminder; offline takes the address down.
suspend.reasonLabel: Reason — the owner reads exactly this text
suspend.reasonHelp: At least five characters. It appears in the community dashboard.

unsuspend.title: Lift the suspension?
unsuspend.text: The community {host} will be reachable as before.

plans.title: Plans & limits (pool)
plans.subtitle: Quota limits per plan — apply to all pool sites without a deploy (take effect within 90 seconds). 0 = unlimited.
plans.saveFailedHint: The previous limits still apply. Whole numbers from 0 upwards are allowed (0 = unlimited).
plans.hint: perDay counts a rolling 24 hours; total = overall per site. 0 means unlimited.

prices.title: Prices (Stripe)
prices.subtitle: Community plan prices — changes create a new price in Stripe and archive the old one. Amounts are GROSS: the landing page and help site show them as final prices incl. 19 % VAT.
prices.unavailable: Stripe unreachable or billing not configured.
prices.grandfatherNote: Existing subscriptions keep their current price (grandfathering) — only new checkouts pay the new price.

abuse.title: Abuse reports
abuse.subtitle: Reports from outside. A report on its own does nothing — you decide here.
abuse.unmatched: Address does not belong to any community
abuse.urlNotLinked: Not an ordinary web link — deliberately not clickable.
abuse.suspendIntro: The community behind {host} goes offline immediately. Content is kept, reachable only by you.
abuse.suspendedHint: {host} is offline, the report is closed.
abuse.noCommunityHint: The reported host does not belong to any community — there is nothing to suspend.

siteDomain.title: Own domain — {name}
siteDomain.fieldHelp: The form the site should live under — with or without www. The other form is set up as well and redirects here.
siteDomain.pendingTitle: This is where it is stuck
siteDomain.noPloiDesc: Without a server and site id no certificate can be ordered. Both are set below.
siteDomain.ploiTitle: Where this site lives at ploi
siteDomain.ploiHelp: Server and site id from the ploi panel. The customer domain is added as an alias to this site; the certificate then covers all names of the site.

status.pending_dns: Waiting for the customer DNS records.
status.pending_cert: DNS is in place. The certificate is being issued.
status.pending_platform: Almost done — the last step is running in the app.

errors.domain_invalid: That does not look like a domain. Letters, digits and hyphens are allowed.
errors.domain_not_a_domain: That is not a complete domain — it needs at least one dot.
errors.domain_operator_domain: Addresses under pukalani.app cannot be added here.
errors.domain_not_ready: The status changed. Reload and check again.
errors.generic: That did not work just now.
